name: trace_relations
description: Trace bounded current relation paths for a project entity. Output includes weighted path scores and an additive recall contract for evidence/source/step inspection. Returns empty unless relation facts have been populated for the project — heuristic distill rarely produces them from natural prose (loop_harness scenario 6 measured 0 facts from 5 memory entries on real-style sessions). Populate via suggest_relation_fact or an LLM-driven distill pass.

relation_type.description: Optional relation type filter, e.g. depends_on

include_history.description: v1.7.2: include historical relation facts. Default false returns current relations only.
